description: GH #37 §B. Rotate Edge CW/CCW; Set Edge Flow (relax an edge loop toward surrounding curvature); Edge Split operator (split along selected / sharp).

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: src/edge_tools.rs (new, ~310 LOC + 4 tests): rotate_edge(edge, cw) (combined-ring of the 2 faces, reconnect via the next verts CW/CCW, re-split), set_edge_flow(loop_edges, iters, strength) (iterative Laplacian relax of loop verts toward their rail-neighbour midpoint), edge_split(edges) (Edge Split modifier as operator — union-find face components not crossing split edges, one vertex copy per extra component). Verified: tri-pair flip a-c -> b-d, kinked loop relaxes toward straight, cube face-loop split duplicates ring verts, empty no-op. clippy clean.

description: Both are uom Ratio aliases for phase volume fraction. During the initial port, closures/turbulence/units.rs defined a local VoidFraction because phase/thermophysical were not yet wired into the module tree. As of the 2026-07-15 integration pass those modules are live, so the two aliases are now a true duplicate. Unify: re-export one from the other, or hoist both to the shared thermal_hydraulics::units. Deferred from the integration pass to avoid churning the verified turbulence closures (op-p6p.7.9). Stale comment already corrected in turbulence/units.rs.
title: genfoam TH: unify VoidFraction (turbulence/units) with phase::phase_base::VolumeFraction
